# MoreHuman Ed

> Tips, ideas and reflections on keeping people at the centre of learning, by Diego Guevara, a science educator. Bilingual (English and Spanish). The site uses no cookies or tracking.

## Pages
- [Home](https://morehumaned.com/): what I'm exploring, videos and where to follow along
- [Videos](https://morehumaned.com/en/tutorials.html): short videos with tips
- [About](https://morehumaned.com/en/about.html): about Diego Guevara
- [How this site works](https://morehumaned.com/en/privacy.html): how AI is used, sources, privacy
- [Inicio (Spanish)](https://morehumaned.com/es/index.html): the site in Spanish

## Elsewhere
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/diego-urrutia-guevara-150bb641/): tips, projects and reflections
- [Discovery Lab](https://morehumaned.com/discovery-lab/): a free collection of interactive science simulations built for my students
